rollups.text: The user’s recurring cooking and food interests/plans include: cooking at home more often and trying new recipes and techniques (approximately 2023-02-21..2023-05-21); Korean-style BBQ pork belly with a sweet-and-spicy marinade, air-fried Brussels sprouts and sweet potatoes, and contemplated Korean-style slaw (2023-05-21); quinoa and black bean salad with grilled chicken and cilantro-lime dressing (2023-05-22..2023-05-28); flaxseed overnight oats (planned 2023-05-22); vegan cashew-based mac and cheese, which the user praised as exceptionally creamy and delicious (2023-05-26); vegan cookies for a potluck (planned 2023-05-26); and weeknight meals, meal prep, and muffin tin noodle cups with peanut sauce (2023-05-27..2023-05-30).

The user has repeatedly pursued or considered exercise and fitness activities: regular yoga classes 2–3 times per week, with goals of improving Downward-Facing Dog and core strength (2023-05-20); returning to regular workouts and building endurance for longer hikes (2023-05-23); soccer agility training to improve footwork (2023-05-23); and a yoga-effects survey project (2023-05-27).

The user has explored watching and listening to media for leisure: completed 20 episodes of Crash Course World History and sought information about the Persian Empire (2023-05-24); watched about 20 hours of Stranger Things and planned to rewatch favorite episodes, while considering Russian Doll (2023-05-27); and sought new storytelling and science podcasts similar to S-Town and Radiolab, expressing interest in The Memory Palace and Ologies (2023-05-29).

The user’s plans for exercise and self-care developed from recognizing that a busy schedule made self-care hard to prioritize (2023-05-20), to returning to workouts and seeking greater stamina for longer hikes (2023-05-23), and then setting manageable goals after reporting anxiety, nightmares, and flashbacks following a car accident about three months earlier (2023-05-30). The user planned to journal about the accident, exercise three times weekly, meditate for 10 minutes five days weekly, and make time for calming activities before bed. They were not ready to discuss their anxiety or goals with others. The elapsed time from the initial self-care difficulty to the specific goals was 10 days; the accident date was not stated.

On 2023-05-21, the user planned Korean-style BBQ pork belly and asked about preparation and side dishes; they chose air-fried Brussels sprouts and sweet potatoes and considered Korean-style slaw. On 2023-05-22, they planned quinoa and black bean salad with grilled chicken and cilantro-lime dressing. On 2023-05-26, they praised a cashew-based vegan mac and cheese and planned cookies for a vegan potluck. On 2023-05-27, they sought quick weeknight meals, healthier snacks, and meal-prep containers; on 2023-05-30, they planned pesto pasta for dinner and breakfast-burrito meal prep. The conversations show ongoing interest in cooking, convenient meals, and trying recipes over nine days.

On 2023-05-23, the user considered tires, a tuning kit, and suspension upgrades for an upcoming auto-racing event, but was concerned about costs after replacing worn brake pads. They decided to start with tires, favoring a middle-ground compound for occasional track use, and planned to compare prices and reviews. They also planned to confirm current rules directly with Speed Demon Racing Track in Pleasanton, California, and sought tire inspection and maintenance resources. The decision followed the brake-pad replacement by about three days; no tire purchase or track event outcome is recorded.

On 2023-05-23, the user reported that a Facebook ad campaign had generated around 50 new leads and increased followers, but they lacked a clear way to attribute sales or sign-ups to those leads. They planned to use an industry benchmark as a temporary conversion estimate, review campaign performance, direct budget toward effective channels and formats, reserve budget for testing, and consider Facebook ROAS bidding. They also wanted to grow the audience and engagement. These were plans and considerations, not reported implementations.

On 2023-05-27, the user was researching whether to replace cable with streaming to save about $50 per month, but worried about losing sports channels. They planned to list and prioritize the channels they use, compare streaming services that carry them, and consult online communities. No decision to cancel cable is recorded.

rollups.text: On 2023-05-27, the user was developing a yoga-effects project and collecting responses with a Google Form. The form included respondent characteristics and a five-point scale covering health, sleep, mood, concentration, social anxiety, activity, and pain. The user planned to use R to compare a second data-collection round with the first, count returning and new respondents, and use assigned user IDs rather than names. No analysis results are recorded.

On 2023-05-28, the user said their city condo had been listed for about three months and they were anxious about how long it was taking to sell. They planned to improve staging and highlight nearby parks, public transportation, and the area’s community-supported agriculture program in the listing. They wanted to be upfront about the time on market. No sale or completed staging changes are recorded.

The user reported eating Domino’s Pizza three times during the week of 2023-05-15..2023-05-21, relying heavily on food delivery during that period, and later said weekends had recently been centered on Uber Eats (2023-05-27). On 2023-05-30, the user again described being busy and relying on delivery, including Fresh Fusion prepared meals. These records show repeated reliance on delivery across at least three dated reports; they do not establish a total order count beyond the three Domino’s meals.

The user’s WhatsApp messaging was about 10–20 messages per day before returning from Europe, then exceeded 500 messages over approximately one month after returning. By 2023-05-30, frequency had decreased slightly from the initial post-trip period but remained high, and the user expected it to stay elevated until their routine settled. The user also reported about 70 Telegram messages in one day with work colleagues and about 12 messages exchanged with a fitness influencer. These are separate reported counts and should not be added as a single comparable total.

The user’s plans regarding egg freezing appear in two records on 2023-05-25: they were researching the process and considering freezing their eggs soon, and separately described it as part of thinking about family plans. No decision, procedure, or change of plan is recorded.

The user said they had been cooking at home much more frequently for the three months leading up to 2023-05-21 and enjoyed new recipes and techniques. In the same period of records, they also reported delivery use, including three Domino’s Pizza meals in the week of 2023-05-15..2023-05-21, and later described Uber Eats as a recent weekend staple. These reports indicate both increased home cooking and recurring delivery reliance; no precise overall frequency comparison is available.
